_help: The Codex: one page per technique (the names guard.inspect gives a query's signature) plus special pages (backups, trickster). Each page's text is in the catalog under codex.page.<id>.title, .text and .dialects. The first time a technique is used (by the player, or demonstrated by a guardian) its page unlocks; the page then shows the guardian's example and the player's own first query.
